indication_area: Chronic hepatitis C virus infection (genotype 1 or 4)
moa: NS5A inhibitor (elbasvir) plus NS3/4A protease inhibitor (grazoprevir) fixed-dose combination
series_start_reason: First quarter the issuer prints a Zepatier line is 2016Q1 (first-quarter 2016 release, filed 2016-05-05, Zepatier 50). Worldwide line in the first dollar column of the product table. Zepatier is Merck's own product from launch, so no prior-owner or partner line is involved.
series_end_reason: No product table in any Merck earnings release from the first-quarter 2021 release (2021-04-29) onward prints a Zepatier row (every 2.02 exhibit checked through 2026-08-04). The 2021 10-Qs for Q1, Q2 and Q3 (accessions 0000310158-21-000009, 0000310158-21-000028, 0000310158-21-000032) and the Q1 2022 10-Q (0000310158-22-000011) print no Zepatier sales figure, only narrative percentages. The FY2021 10-K (accession 0000310158-22-000003) prints a full-year Zepatier row (2021: 128; 2020: 167; 2019: 370), which is annual and is not written as a quarterly figure. Quarters 2016Q1-2020Q4 sum to the printed full years 2016 (555), 2017 (1,659 vs 1,660), 2018 (456 vs 455), 2019 (371 vs 370) and 2020 (167).
notes: The quarterly series ends at the last quarter in which a Zepatier row is printed. Annual full-year values for 2021 onward appear in the 10-K; later 10-K years were not checked. Scope: the row labelled Zepatier in each product table, first dollar column (worldwide); the 2016-2017 release lines label the product in upper case in the summary table and in title case in the detailed table, both read as the same line. The 2016 and early-2017 values for Q1 2016 include a zero prior-year column (no sales in Q1 2015).
